---
name: Propose research hypothesis
about: Propose a falsifiable small-cap research question
---

## Mechanism
What economic mechanism could generate the effect?

## Hypothesis
State the exact measurable prediction and comparison.

## Unit and observation date
Company-quarter, company-year, or security-month? What information was available?

## Baseline
What established model or null hypothesis must be beaten?

## Data requirements and biases
Describe sources, missingness, historical coverage and leakage risks.

## What would falsify it?
Specify the null, effect size and pre-registration details.
